top.line: Forking as the way people adopt our cells and template sites, as GitHub made it for code.
top.para: Five ways to make a cell yours, fork-ready repositories, paths, and usage deciding what we build.

in-short.line: Forking; fork and point Claude; five ways; paths; fork-ready; usage decides; the brief.

why.line: Fork a site's repository, point Claude at the copy, and it is yours: it works on GitHub today.
why.para: Our job is to make it smooth for a stranger.

paths.line: Fork on GitHub, one-click deploy, run in your assistant, take it as a vault, or ask us.
paths.para: Four free, one on the ladder.

chains.line: Paths of small repositories, each one a step Claude can be pointed at.
chains.para: From a one-page site to an agentic team.

ready.line: Our template is factory-ready; fork-ready needs a prompt, a general CLAUDE.md, one settings file, a policy, updates.
ready.para: Built for a stranger with Claude.

loop.line: Make many templates, list them, watch what is forked, invest where it pulls, keep forks alive.

brief.line: A template organisation, a fork-ready template, twenty templates, five buttons, three paths, stranger tests, counts.

limits.line: A plan; deploy and hosting options to check per template; no template organisation yet.
